Prices

Maintenance Prices

Prices are listed up front. If anything extra is needed, you get the price before we do the work.

Safety and combustion checks, burner, flame sensor and ignition cleaning, venting, blower and a full heating cycle. If anything else is needed, we explain it and give you the price before doing the work.

Burner and boiler cleaning with a new nozzle, oil filter and pump strainer, then a check of ignition, safety controls and the whole system. Extra cleaning may be needed if the boiler hasn’t been serviced in three years.

Refrigerant and pressure checks, electrical connections, condenser motor and fan, evaporator coil, condensate drain flush and treatment, and a standard 1-inch filter.

Preventive maintenance for rooftop units up to 10 tons at restaurants, offices and shops. Plus tax; repairs and parts are quoted separately.
